北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京风大天冷，记得多穿保暖，别着凉哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is windy and cold, remember to dress warmly to avoid catching a cold!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪体感偏凉，风力较大，出门记得添衣哦！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi feels cool with strong winds, remember to add layers when you go out!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天微凉，体感偏低，记得多穿一件衣服。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is overcast and cool, remember to put on an extra layer.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阳光正好，气温舒适，适合户外活动哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou has lovely sunshine and a comfortable temperature, perfect for outdoor activities!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳温暖晴朗，阳光充足，记得补充水分哦！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is warm and sunny, remember to stay hydrated!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴冷潮湿，体感较凉，别忘了穿暖和点。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cold and damp, feels quite chilly, don't forget to dress warmly.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天体感较冷，出门注意保暖，小心感冒。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing feels quite cold today, remember to keep warm when you go out to avoid catching a cold.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，气温适中，但早晚温差大，注意添衣。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast with moderate temperatures, but there's a big day-night difference, remember to add layers.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉有雾，能见度低，开车请注意安全，慢行。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is foggy with low visibility, please drive safely and slowly.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安天冷干燥，体感温度低，多喝水注意保暖。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cold and dry, with a low apparent temperature, drink more water and stay warm.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆下小雨，路面湿滑，出门记得带伞注意安全。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing has light rain, roads are slippery, remember to bring an umbrella and stay safe.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨极寒，请务必全副武装，注意防冻保暖！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is extremely cold, please bundle up and take precautions against frostbite!
哈尔滨.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -17℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳天晴但严寒，体感超冷，出门请注意防寒。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny but severely cold, it feels extremely chilly, please protect yourself from the cold when you go out.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天，微凉舒适，早晚温差大，注意添减衣物。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is overcast and mildly cool, with a significant day-night temperature difference, remember to adjust your clothing.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门风力较大，体感较凉，出门要注意防风保暖。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen has strong winds, making it feel cooler, remember to protect yourself from the wind and keep warm.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛风大天冷，体感很低，出门记得多穿保暖！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is windy and cold, with a very low apparent temperature, remember to dress warmly when you go out!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连天晴但寒冷，体感偏低，记得穿厚外套保暖。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is sunny but cold, with a low apparent temperature, remember to wear a thick coat to stay warm.
